event: Multiple September 2 reports state PONS has been listed on Robinhood, while the trading-opening time had not yet been disclosed in those reports.
source_quality_note: This was reported by Gate News and Binance News citing Odaily; no direct Robinhood announcement was located in this run, so the listing is treated as reported/announced rather than independently confirmed live trading.
interpretation: If live trading becomes directly confirmed, this is a major distribution/access catalyst for the incumbent Robinhood Chain leader. It also lowers the purity of subsequent price persistence as an endogenous ecosystem-flow signal, because centralized/main-app access can independently expand demand.
